name: Seeing What Happens
summary: The miniature platinum discs may hold a connection to Uldum. You are asked to take them to Uldum’s gates and look for clues.

sections.title: At Uldum’s Gates
sections.body: The gates of Uldum in Tanaris are where you can search for clues. Bring the miniature platinum discs there and look for a connection between the place and the discs.

faq.q: What am I looking for at Uldum?
faq.answer: You are looking for clues to how the miniature platinum discs connect to Uldum.

faq.q: Where do I take the platinum discs?
faq.answer: Take the miniature platinum discs to the gates of Uldum in Tanaris.

faq.q: What is the connection between Tanaris and Uldum?
faq.answer: Uldum lies within Tanaris. The real question is how the platinum discs connect to Uldum, and the clues at its gates may reveal that.
